newsitem.title: GERMANY: Compuserve users to get cheaper access in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Compuserve users to get cheaper access in Germany.

text.p: Compuserve GmbH , German unit of the U.S. online service, said it has won an agreement allowing users cheaper access via Deutsche Telekom AG's telephone lines.
Compuserve's 290,000 users throughout Germany will now be able to dial in using "City" rates instead of long-distance.
For those who access the service via Deutsche Telekom nodes, the access fee will be $1 per hour.
